'''Tom Lischke''' is a Decipher product / game designer who appeared on contemporary Radio Free Decipher with [[Jerry Darcy]] and [[Chuck Kallenbach]] on SWCCG topics, and later on ''Jedi Knights'' and ''The Lord of the Rings'' TCG design broadcasts.<ref name="rfd">[https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Radio_Free_Decipher Radio Free Decipher episode index], LOTR-TCG PC wiki</ref><ref name="tor-chat">[http://archives.theonering.net/events/logs/201001.html TheOneRing Chat &mdash; Tom Lischke and Chuck Kallenbach], 20 October 2001 (archives)</ref>

This page is a '''fan encyclopedia''' stub focused on SWCCG-related, sourced roles. It does not invent unpublished job titles beyond what cited indexes and interviews state.

== SWCCG and Decipher design roles (sourced labels) ==

The Radio Free Decipher index lists Lischke with Darcy and Kallenbach on Broadcast 2 (11 December 1998), in the same episode that bills Darcy as Star Wars CCG Lead Game Designer.<ref name="rfd" /><ref name="rfd2">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w2Ao759YJlk RFD Broadcast 2], YouTube <code>w2Ao759YJlk</code> (Player's Council upload)</ref> Broadcast 51 (22 September 2000) indexes him on the Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck product.<ref name="rfd51">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2tQmFqhsx74 RFD Broadcast 51 &mdash; Tom Lischke (Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck)], YouTube <code>2tQmFqhsx74</code></ref>

Those RFD index labels support Decipher design / product-design work adjacent to late SWCCG products. They do '''not''', by themselves, place Lischke on Wikipedia's founding SWCCG designer line ([[Tom Braunlich]], [[Rollie Tesh]], [[Warren Holland]], [[Jerry Darcy]]).<ref name="wp-swccg">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game Star Wars Customizable Card Game], Wikipedia (designer credit line)</ref> The GeoCities anagram table unscrambles [[Lieutenant Sheckil]] as Tom Lischke.<ref name="ana">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians]</ref>

== Jedi Knights / LOTR / WARS ==

RFD indexes and TheOneRing materials bill Lischke on ''Jedi Knights'' and LOTR TCG design topics (including a joint 2001 chat with Kallenbach as LOTR designers).<ref name="rfd" /><ref name="tor-chat" /><ref name="tor-lotr">[https://www.theonering.net/torwp/2002/02/14/26785-decipher-talks-lotr/ Decipher Talks LOTR], TheOneRing.net, 14 February 2002</ref> Decipher WARS Radio later featured Lischke on WARS TCG design segments.<ref name="wars02">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ikcgtmhuhbc WARS Radio 02 &mdash; Tom Lischke], YouTube <code>Ikcgtmhuhbc</code></ref>
